sem0235: Albin Sem came up with a draft of replacements on Day 5. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Albin Sem shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
tonyhuang000: Florian Tonyhuang was a ferryman in Coldwater until the posters went up. He came to S-F6 with a tin of tobacco, and within a day the whole bay knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.
Verdel Ridge is lost. Florian Tonyhuang heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Florian Tonyhuang began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

The barrage caught Florian Tonyhuang in the open at S-F6. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Florian Tonyhuang was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Florian Tonyhuang slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
Zeno Tonyhuang came to the front because his father Florian Tonyhuang never came home. He carries a tin of tobacco.
A rat stole Zeno Tonyhuang's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
